description: Render managed MDE config before service start, then onboard

runCommand: if [ "$SSM_DeriveAtBoot" = 'true' ]; then TOKEN=$(curl -fsS -X PUT -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600' http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token); ACCOUNT_ID=$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/document | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["accountId"])'); SUFFIX=$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/tags/instance/MdeTagSuffix); MDE_DEVICE_TAG="${ACCOUNT_ID}-${SUFFIX}"; fi

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
tag = os.environ['MDE_DEVICE_TAG']
if not tag.strip() or len(tag) > 200 or any(ch in tag for ch in ',()'):
    raise SystemExit('invalid MDE device tag')
template = pathlib.Path('/opt/lab/mdatp_managed.json.tmpl').read_text()
rendered = template.replace('__MDE_DEVICE_TAG_JSON__', json.dumps(tag))
pathlib.Path('/tmp/mdatp_managed.json').write_text(rendered)
PY

ORG_ID=$(mdatp health --field org_id 2>&1 || true); if printf '%s' "$ORG_ID" | grep -Eiq '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}'; then echo 'MDE is already onboarded; skipping onboarding script'; else aws s3 cp "$SSM_OnboardingS3Uri" /opt/lab/MicrosoftDefenderATPOnboardingLinuxServer.py --only-show-errors; chmod 0700 /opt/lab/MicrosoftDefenderATPOnboardingLinuxServer.py; python3 /opt/lab/MicrosoftDefenderATPOnboardingLinuxServer.py; fi
